changed_factors: Planned only: one factor per candidate-scoring, dense-coverage, lookup, or retrieval comparison

Official public train/catalog only; G5-s42; vessel-isolated fit-inner selection
No new training, inference, metric experiment, or submission ZIP in this task
commands: Read-only AS09 ZIP source/hash inspection and existing experiment-record review
observations: AS09 ZIP hash matches historical local record
Dense scoring is present only for dense Top35 candidates
Callsign/name lookup may return before comparative scoring; missing tonnage passes its compatibility check
Non-Hangul branch has no global ngram TopK or dense channel
Tail similarity and sister bonus produced by hybrid matcher are not consumed by submitted scoring
interpretations: Possible scoring/lookup/retrieval weaknesses are hypotheses; no server error attribution or expected gain is measured

Full-fit AS09 assets cannot serve as heldout OOF models
Legacy map generation binding and historical training-source mismatch require lineage reconciliation
Windows Python3.11.15 versus target3.11.17 and eval_kit actual1.0 versus requested1.1 remain
